scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run web:build
scripts.release:tag: node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const tag = 'tauri-v' + require('./package.json').version; execFileSync('git', ['tag', '-a', tag, '-m', 'Release ' + tag], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.release:push: node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const tag = 'tauri-v' + require('./package.json').version; execFileSync('git', ['push', 'origin', 'tauri_master'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); execFileSync('git', ['push', 'origin', tag], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.release: npm run release:tag && npm run release:push
